Anjali Jain
Senior Financial Analyst | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
anjali.jain698@example.com | +91 9890479591

A detail-oriented financial analyst with strong FP&A and financial modeling capabilities, combining technical tooling and business partnering to drive forecasting accuracy and actionable insights. Proven track record delivering month-end close improvements, variance root-cause analysis, and interactive dashboards that inform executive decisions.

Experience

Vertex Analytics — Nov 2022 - Jul 2026
Financial Analyst, Hybrid
- Built rolling FP&A forecasts and scenario models in Advanced Excel and Financial Modeling templates, reducing forecast variance by 18% quarter-over-quarter and improving cash-flow visibility for leadership.
- Developed Power BI executive dashboards consolidating multi-entity P&L and balance sheet metrics; enabled a 30% faster month-end review cycle and supported board-level presentations with drillable visuals.
- Led monthly variance analysis and narrative commentary using Advanced Excel and Confluence notes, identifying cost drivers that enabled a 12% reduction in discretionary spend over two quarters.
- Implemented SAP FICO data extraction routines and Git-tracked transformation scripts to standardize monthly reporting feeds, cutting data prep time by 40%.

Razorpay — Jul 2021 - Oct 2022
Financial Analyst, Remote
- Created detailed Financial Modeling for product profitability and pricing experiments using Advanced Excel, informing a pricing change that increased gross margin by 4 percentage points on select products.
- Produced Power BI reports for payments volume and revenue trends, enabling ops teams to identify friction points and decrease transaction decline rates by 6% after remediation.
- Performed monthly Variance Analysis on revenue and cost cohorts; authored Confluence playbooks for recurring variance drivers that reduced ad-hoc inquiry volume by 25%.
- Integrated SAP FICO extracts into finance models and maintained version control of model logic using Git to ensure auditability and reproducibility during quarter close.

Projects
- Subscription Cohort Model: Built a subscription revenue cohort model in Advanced Excel and Power BI to model LTV and churn scenarios; model informed retention strategy that prioritized high-LTV segments.
- Close Automation Toolkit: Developed a set of Excel macros and Git-managed transformation scripts to automate routine reconciliations, reducing manual close steps and saving ~10 hours per month.

Skills
Languages: Advanced Excel, Financial Modeling
FP&A & Tools: FP&A, Power BI, Variance Analysis
ERP & Collaboration: SAP FICO, Confluence
Dev & Versioning: Git

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS
